$description: Closed set of motion patterns observed in the clone; each carries its fixed reduced-motion fallback.

patterns.description: No motion; content renders in its final state.
Layer appear: opacity 0.001 -> 1, scale 1.6 -> 1, spring 0.8 bounce 0 (nav layer, home hero, case/legal/post intros).
Home card stack: cards rise from +100vh with 1.1-1.4s springs, fan out on hover, exit to -100vh past scrollY 30 and re-enter at top.
Staggered lines: words translateY 100% -> 0, 600ms cubic-bezier(.4,1,.4,1), 120ms per line, in view once.
Characters rise translateY 50-300px -> 0 inside a clip, duration spring, stagger 0.025s.
Words fly in from seeded random offsets (spread 1000) as the heading top moves from vh to vh/2.
Statement words light up in a seeded shuffled order tied to scroll, then the block fades out.
Scroll-linked translateY (image parallax, offset columns/cards) smoothed by spring {340,60,1}.
Sticky box swaps state (digit columns roll, photo cross-fades, 1.6s spring) when a row marker crosses mid-viewport.
Rows rise y 100 -> 0 and fade 0 -> 1 with scroll progress, spring {500,100,3.3}.
Timeline bars grow from 1px to full width, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,0,1), label slides x -20 -> 0.
Image revealed by a left-to-right mask wipe, 1.2s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.4,1), in view once.
One slide visible, 10s autoplay that only runs while the slideshow is on screen (the countdown restarts on entry and after every change), 0.3s fade-out / swap / fade-in; prev/next buttons.
Horizontal scroll-snap carousel with dot buttons (touch).
Price digits roll per digit (NumberFlow-style, ~1.17s) when the billing toggle changes; pill slides with spring 0.4.
Accordion row clip height tweens 0.8s between closed and open; plus icon rotates 45 degrees.
Sticky heading opacity 1 -> 0.02 as the grid marker crosses 240px of viewport, spring-smoothed.
Footer wordmark uncovered by six slats whose white bars shrink 100% -> 0 with scroll.
Hover rolls each letter up one line, 0.4s cubic-bezier(.8,0,.4,1), stagger 0.03s (>=1200).
Hover micro-interactions: card image zoom 1.2, underline growth, arrow swap, logo scale (spring 0.4-0.6).
Infinite wrap-around canvas moved by wheel and drag with lerp easing; cards repeat in a 2600x2300 tile.
Three columns auto-scroll vertically at different speeds/directions; wheel steers and boosts.
Endless horizontal loop at 100 px/s with a scroll-velocity boost (capped 1000, decay e^-6t).
Muted looping inline video.
Custom cursor follows the pointer on spring {340,60,1}; variant size/icon changes spring 0.4.
Photo cards spawn every 163px of pointer travel, fade in 0.4s, out after 1s.
Clock text refreshes every 1000ms.
Overlay opens and closes instantly (no tween).
Backdrop opacity 0.001 -> 1 (spring 0.6), close button enters from the corner after 1.2s.
Submit button Idle -> Loading (spinner, 1500ms) -> Success ('Thank you' + check).
404 digit columns slide from offset positions to the code with a 1.6s spring while gradient blobs loop.
